provenance.source_title: Why It Sucks to Be Handsome in Ancient Greece

examples.psychological_goal: 第一秒用身份指派把观众扔进场景，并叠加三层幸运标签为后面的反转蓄势
examples.expression_mechanism: 指令式开场 + 第二人称身份指派 + 幸运属性三连堆叠
examples.example_text: Picture this. You are a young aspiring athlete living in the glorious city of ancient Athens.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'想象一下+你是某身份'一句话完成沉浸开场，身份标签越幸运越好
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该时代、地点与身份设定

examples.psychological_goal: 用一串终身代价把荒诞开场的赌注瞬间拉到致命级别
examples.expression_mechanism: 情态动词+代价名词三连排比的赌注句
examples.example_text: could literally lose your human rights, your career, and your right to vote for the rest of your natural life.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在荒诞画面之后立刻接一句终身代价清单，让好笑与恐惧同时成立
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该代价清单内容

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句现代官僚隐喻把浪漫化想象定性为噩梦，制造智力优越的笑点
examples.expression_mechanism: basically + 现代机构隐喻 + but with 追加荒诞细节
examples.example_text: It was basically the HR department of hell, but with more olive oil and federal lawsuits.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'本质上是某现代机构，但多了某时代细节'的公式为古代现实一秒定性
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该机构与细节措辞

examples.psychological_goal: 给出全片总钥匙：这个社会只用一种透镜解读一切关系
examples.expression_mechanism: 心智视角限定 + 严格二分断言 + 二选一平行句
examples.example_text: To the ancient Athenian mind, the world was strictly divided into two categories. You were either dominant or you were submissive.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先限定'在某人的心智里'，再用二分平行句交出解释框架
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该框架内容；二分维度必须贴合目标主题

examples.psychological_goal: 用现代家庭理财画面翻译古代配偶的憋屈日常，制造愤愤不平的笑点
examples.expression_mechanism: the ancient equivalent of + 现代生活场景 的假设重演
examples.example_text: You're sitting at home doing the ancient equivalent of extreme couponing to keep the family budget afloat
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把古代劳作翻译成现代生活场景，让制度的荒谬自动显现
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该场景与类比

examples.psychological_goal: 用最高级预警把观众注意力拽到下一个场景
examples.expression_mechanism: Let's talk about + the absolute worst + 场景点名 的转场句
examples.example_text: Let's talk about the absolute worst place to be a student in this society, the gymnasium.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'来谈谈最糟糕的X'的口头转场切换场景，最高级制造期待
examples.negative_instruction: 不要机械套用该句式，转场目标必须是观众关心的维度

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个现代软件类比为古代场所的本质一秒定性
examples.expression_mechanism: was basically a real life + 现代软件 的定性句
examples.example_text: the gymnasium was basically a real life dating app.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在场景细节铺完后用一句现代定性收束，笑点与信息同时落地
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该软件类比

examples.psychological_goal: 解释家庭为何共谋：被高位者选中等于拿到前途入场券
examples.expression_mechanism: the ancient version of + 现代职场跳板 的利益类比
examples.example_text: It was basically the ancient Greek version of getting a prestigious internship at a massive law firm.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用现代职场类比解释古人的利益计算，让共谋逻辑立刻可懂
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该职业类比

examples.psychological_goal: 正式回扣开场道具，把观众悬挂已久的疑惑拉到台前
examples.expression_mechanism: 程度副词堆叠的定性 + Which brings us back to + 贯穿道具
examples.example_text: the ancient Greek language of love was deeply profoundly weird. Which brings us back to the live chicken.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'这让我们回到开场的X'句式回收早期悬念道具
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该道具；回扣对象必须是开场已建立的具体物件

examples.psychological_goal: 用连续追问把荒诞道具的日常处置尴尬推到极致
examples.expression_mechanism: 反问句 + 连续处置方案追问 的物流推演
examples.example_text: What are you supposed to do with it? Do you put it in your gym bag?
examples.usage_instruction: 学习对荒诞设定追问'那具体怎么办'，用日常物流细节放大笑点
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该物品与场景

examples.psychological_goal: 让当事人在狂欢中的孤立处境被具身感受，制造憋屈的共鸣
examples.expression_mechanism: 状态词堆叠 + 旁观画面白描 的反差长句
examples.example_text: you had to sit there completely sober, maintaining perfect posture, watching a room full of middle-aged men get absolutely hammered
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'你必须保持A、保持B、看着别人放纵'的对比长句制造代入式憋屈
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该场景与措辞

examples.psychological_goal: 亮出全片最反人性的禁令，让观众意识到系统的真正冷酷
examples.expression_mechanism: completely 三连修饰的禁令断言
examples.example_text: You had to act completely cold, completely bored, and completely emotionless.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用同一副词三连排比把一条禁令的语气推到极端
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该禁令内容

examples.psychological_goal: 用雕塑意象把仪式中的去人格化要求压缩成一个画面
examples.expression_mechanism: stand there like + 冷物意象 + 微动作补充
examples.example_text: You basically had to stand there like a cold marble statue, counting the tiles on the floor
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'像某冷物一样站着+一个微小动作'的组合呈现被迫的麻木
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该意象

examples.psychological_goal: 揭示资格的身体倒计时：一个生理信号即终结整个身份
examples.expression_mechanism: the exact second + 生理信号 + 身份即时反转 的定时句
examples.example_text: exact second you started growing a beard, you were officially considered an adult citizen.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'从某信号出现的确切一秒起'句式把身份反转压缩成瞬间事件
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该信号与身份设定

examples.psychological_goal: 给出惩罚的专有名称与定义，让恐惧获得制度实体
examples.expression_mechanism: 专名 + literally translates to + 直白定义 的命名句
examples.example_text: Aimeia literally translates to disenfranchisement or the total loss of citizen rights.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先给惩罚起名字再一句话翻译其含义，名称本身就制造寒意
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该术语与定义

examples.psychological_goal: 用现代税务机构画面暴露制度一边惩罚一边抽成的双标
examples.expression_mechanism: 现代机构绰号 + 敲门要账的画面化推演
examples.example_text: the IRS of Athens is knocking on your door, demanding a 20% cut of your profits to fund the military.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把制度双标翻译成现代机构上门要账的画面，让愤怒以笑点形式释放
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该机构绰号与数字

examples.psychological_goal: 把真实判例定性为古代版的舆论封杀事件，让观众用现代经验丈量其规模
examples.expression_mechanism: the ancient equivalent of + 现代舆论事件 + but with 真实后果 的定性句
examples.example_text: It was the ancient equivalent of a massive internet cancellation, but with actual legal consequences.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'古代版X，但有真实后果'的公式为判例定性并抬高严重性
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该类比与转折

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句反差定性为支线高潮盖章：不败强权终结于最不像军队的东西
examples.expression_mechanism: 最高级主体 + 被 + 反差主体 + 幽默比喻 的判词长句
examples.example_text: The most fearsome warriors in the world got their military supremacy permanently ended by 150 couples having the most aggressive date night in human history.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在高潮事实后用'最强者被最反差者终结'的判词完成情绪封顶
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该战绩与比喻

examples.psychological_goal: 把全部规则收束为对系统本质的一句话定性，完成从猎奇到批判的升级
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定假象 + 肯定本质 的系统判词
examples.example_text: It was a rigid, terrifying hierarchy designed completely to keep older dominant men in power
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在结尾前用'这不是A而是一台为B服务的机器'的句式给系统定性
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该定性内容

examples.psychological_goal: 用'本可以更糟'的感恩反转收束全片，并回扣开场意象留下余味
examples.expression_mechanism: 现代烦恼共情 + could be worse 反转 + 开场画面回扣
examples.example_text: could be just trying to get a quick workout in while a 40-year-old politician corners you near the weights, hands you a live screaming chicken
examples.usage_instruction: 学习结尾先共情观众的现代小烦恼，再用开场意象证明'你已经算幸运'
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该画面与人物设定
